text:
lena-partnerships: quick sync: onboarding NimbusCloud for new boreal-north2 region. need marketplace SKU entitlements, KMS handoff pattern, and approval for a joint announcement slot. cc @omar-sales @rachel-partner-success
chris-eng: can you paste SKU IDs and expected qps? i'll validate capacity mapping.
mohit-ops: FYI Nimbus sets a 120 vGPU soft quota in boreal-north2 by default. quota bump needs 48h lead.
lena-partnerships: initial ask: nimbus.a100x.large x12 + nimbus.ctrl.small x6. steady ~90 rps, peak ~300 rps.
chris-eng: good. need exact SKU slugs from partner portal for infra changes.
rachel-partner-success: partner exported slugs: nimbus.a100x.large, nimbus.ctrl.small. uploaded to partner drive.
lena-partnerships: KMS note: Nimbus requires partner-managed CMEK for marketplace images. @tara-legal any special wording we must add?
tara-legal: cannot share our master key. we accept partner-managed CMEK when customers BYOK. i'll draft an addendum: tenant key ownership, no key material in exported logs, and explicit audit scope. ETA 24h.
omar-sales: Nimbus marketing asked for a coordinated announcement within 10 days after capacity confirmed. can we meet that?
mohit-ops: operational timeline: if we request quota today and get approval in 48h, soft-lift in ~72h. SLA-backed dedicated pools take ~14 days (certs/procurement).
chris-eng: current blockers: 1) quota ticket id, 2) validated CMEK image, 3) routing entries for boreal-north2. i'll open infra PR once we have ticket + slugs.
lena-partnerships: opening quota ticket now: using nimbusctl:
```nimbusctl quota request --region boreal-north2 --sku nimbus.a100x.large --qty 12 --reason "Redwood Dedicated initial pool for Nimbus launch"```
lena-partnerships: ticket CN-TKT-7724 created (linked). pls reference. @chris-eng @mohit-ops
chris-eng: got CN-TKT-7724. starting preflight matrix. will share soon.
rachel-partner-success: partner wants a smoke test: model pull + 40 requests, p50 <160ms. coordinating window.
tara-legal: adding embargo clause: no public announcement until addendum signed and capacity verified. drafting now.
omar-sales: i'll prep marketing assets but hold publish until ops greenlights.
deploy-bot: Checklist created for region boreal-north2: r/infrastructure/regions/boreal-north2/checks - status: pending (autoscaler, routing, certs, kms).
mohit-ops: cost note: Nimbus A100 pricing is variable; recommend budget alert for pool during ramp.
lena-partnerships: agreed. @chris-eng can you add budget alert and tag resources partner:nimbus?
chris-eng: yes. infra PR will include tags, alerts, and autoscaler profile.
lena-partnerships: timeline recap: CN-TKT-7724 opened; legal addendum by @tara-legal in 24h; infra PR by @chris-eng in ~36h; partner smoke test by @rachel-partner-success within 72h. target soft-launch announcement in 8 days if all passes. objections?
tara-legal: none. will ping when draft is ready.
omar-sales: good. holding public comms.
rachel-partner-success: collecting partner logo and one-liner for marketplace tile. uploading to shared drive.
chris-eng: preflight matrix (short): 1) provision reserved pool (12x a100x) 2) verify CMEK image pulls 3) perf smoke (40 reqs, p50 <160ms) 4) autoscaler reacts to 300rps burst 5) routing fallback to us-east if capacity exhausted 6) confirm billing tags & budget alerts
lena-partnerships: thanks all. will update when legal draft or quota status changes. tagging this #boreal-north2-nimbus-onboard
